detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Survive relentless waves of enemies in this intense roguelite bullet heaven where you play as a battle-hardened pickle armed with an ever-expanding arsenal. Master dodge rolls, chain powerful abilities, and craft unique builds each run as you fight to save a world consumed by darkness.

Key Features

  • Roguelite Progression - Unlock permanent upgrades and new weapons between runs while discovering fresh build combinations every playthrough

  • Bullet Hell Combat - Weave through intense enemy patterns with precision dodge mechanics and strategic positioning

  • Vast Arsenal - Experience 80+ unique weapons, from rapid-fire machine guns to devastating rocket launchers

  • Epic Boss Encounters - Challenge massive bosses with unique attack patterns and multi-phase battles

  • Dynamic Build Crafting - Combine weapons, abilities, and upgrades to create powerful synergies

  • Diverse Biomes - Battle through haunted forests, corrupted wastelands, and ancient ruins, each with distinct enemies and hazards

How does the demo compared to the full game?

  • The demo contains 5 levels (full game has 32)

  • Sidekicks (companion feature) are not available

  • Characters (unique dodge roll abilities and appearences) are not available

  • Some items and weapons are not available in the demo (they are locked behind quests that are tied to the unavailable levels)

  • Progress in the demo will carry over to the full version

Endless Replayability

No two runs are the same. Experiment with countless build combinations, discover hidden synergies, and push deeper into increasingly challenging territories. Every death teaches you something new, every run brings you closer to salvation.

Can you survive the darkness and save what remains of the world?
